pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, blotchy dark regions with soft, diffuse edge gradients. Patch geometry is inconsistent, ranging from sub-circular to multi-lobed polygons across the mid-section and neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected topological graph of light-colored pelage with varying thickness. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial, maintaining continuity across the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette. The mane presents as a continuous, jagged 1D geometric contour against the out-of-focus background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two avian symbionts (Oxpeckers) on the subject's body; one is positioned on the lower forelimb/chest area, and the other is partially visible on the upper dorsal neck.
